subject: Quick recap + next steps from our discovery (follow-up)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fenixfinance.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from our discovery (follow-up)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for carving out 30 minutes today. Quick recap from my side and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

What I heard:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost on your customer-facing scoring pipeline without increasing 95th-pct latency beyond 60ms.
- Current footprint: single-region GCP with mixed A100/RTX workloads, roughly 6M tokens/day.
- Constraints: SOC 2 requirements + need to keep PII on-prem for certain datasets.

Suggested next steps:
1) POC scope: 2-week POC to validate throughput and tail latency with a representative 10k/day traffic replay (we propose Dedicated pool + prefix caching).
2) Tech touch: schedule 60-min bucketed run-through with your infra and security folks to confirm networking & KMS details.
3) Commercial: sketch of dedicated capacity pricing & an uplift scenario if you want burst capacity.

Can you share availability for the tech touch next week (Mon/Tue windows preferred)? I attached my discovery notes and a short POC brief to make it easier to align.

Attachments: discovery-notes-0903.pdf (3 pages), redwood-poc-brief.pdf (2 pages)

Thanks — happy to adjust scope based on what you need.

— Hannah

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Subject: Checking in on timing for POC / next steps

Alex —

Following up again. We’re lining up a small Dedicated cluster for an upcoming POC slot and wanted to see if Fenix is still evaluating Redwood for the scoring workload. If your timelines shifted, I can either:
- hold an initial slot for the week of 9/28, or
- move you to our waitlist and circle back in a month.

If helpful, here’s a one-pager with the expected metrics we’ll measure during the POC: latency p95, tokens/sec, and unit cost after caching.

Quick thumbs up / thumbs down is fine.

Thanks,
— Hannah

Subject: Final check — should I close your file for now?

Hi Alex —

I haven’t heard back on the POC timing, so I wanted to do one final check before I close the file on our side. If Fenix is still interested, we’re happy to:
- hold the 9/28 POC slot for 48 hours while you gather approvals, or
- pause outreach and reopen when the timing is better (I’ll add a reminder to circle back).

If I don’t hear anything by EOD Monday I’ll archive this outreach to keep my active pipeline clean — you’re absolutely welcome to re-open later and I’ll pick up where we left off.

Thanks again for the time, and feel free to reply with your preferred path or a quick calendar time.

Best,
